items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: I used to play with Punch Miller.

ctx.x: Who were some of those guys?
Well, I used to play with Punch Miller. He'd come over there. I used to play with Dude Foster. He'd come over there. Rene.
Now who is Dude Foster? Is that the trumpet player? Yeah. What, did he have a brother?

items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: Rainey, Punch Miller, Buddy PT. I can't think of his name right now, but they had a lot of bands come out of here.

ctx.x: I just wondered, didn't they have some other bands that came over here that you'd hear and maybe sit in with? Yes.

Sam Morgan was here, he was the drawing card here. Rainey, Punch Miller, Buddy PT. I can't think of his name right now, but they had a lot of bands come out of here. But the man that gave me my inspiration was Joe Watson. He was playing Craneet with Sam Morgan. He was a very sweet Craneet player. And I used to stay right under him every time he'd come here. I was right under him. I liked the way he played Craneet. Chris Kelly, he was out of here. Used to come out here a lot. Who did he have with him? I'm sorry.
Go ahead. I was just playing for Sam, of course. Who did he have with him, Chris, when he was here, Your Honor? Who was brought to him?

items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-05
items.q: Such as Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly, Riddick, Riddick, Riddick, Punch Miller. ... I used to hear them.

ctx.x: I was wondering about some of the bands you heard when you were a kid. When you were very young, before you even started playing. Do you remember any other than your father's band?

I mentioned the few I heard. As a matter of fact, I heard practically all of them because they used to come out there on that coast. Such as Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly, Riddick, Riddick, Riddick, Punch Miller. Uh, a band used to come out there called the Maple Leaf Band. That was with, uh, Freddie Kepert. He used to lead that band. And all those boys used to come out there. I used to hear them. Matter of fact, they used to have what you call a trolley ride from Biloxi to Peskristad. It hooked five or six, uh,…
Who was in your daddy's band? Did he have a band of his own or what?
